recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, white-background composition featuring a full-body female figure on the left side, juxtaposed with right-aligned, multi-tiered typography in vibrant pink and deep blue. The figure blends showgirl aesthetics with tactical gear, creating a visual tension between elegance and grit.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the far left, looking toward the viewer while interacting with footwear.
Text block anchored to the right, balanced by the subject's vertical presence.
Contrast between the soft textures of feathers/sequins and the hard edges of tactical boots/holsters.
High-key white negative space separating the subject from the information block.
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no horizon line.
Subject's leg raised in a dynamic 'getting ready' pose.
Dual-tone color scheme for text (Magenta/Pink and Navy/Black).

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure occupies the left vertical third of the frame, scaled to nearly the full height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's black tactical boot at the bottom left provides a heavy visual weight against the white void.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the boot, then jumps across the white space to the large title text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the center and right-middle creates a clean, modern aesthetic.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta/Hot Pink (Primary Text and Subject Accents)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/Yellow (Subject's Outfit) and Navy Blue (Title Text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pinks and golds against a neutral white background creates a 'pop' effect.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a heavy, condensed sans-serif with tight tracking.
Secondary taglines use a fluid, slanted script.
Credit blocks use a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerical '2' is significantly larger and stylized in a different color than the preceding word.

composition.overlap: slight vertical overlap with script text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed sans-serif for impact paired with a feminine script for thematic contrast.
graphicDevices: Bullet points (dots) separating names in the credit block
Drop shadow on the main title for legibility against white

preserve: Right alignment of the text block
avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy condensed feel of the main title.
Captures the informal, energetic feel of the tagline.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body shot of a woman in a gold sequined outfit with a pink feather boa, wearing one black combat boot and holding a gold heel, standing against a pure white studio background. Leave the right half of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the empty space. Use a heavy navy condensed sans-serif for the main title, a magenta script for the tagline below it, and a magenta sans-serif for the list of names at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the subject confined to the left third?
Are the colors magenta and navy represented in the text?

adjustableVariables: Specific names in the credit block
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlaps the subject.
Check that the '2' in the title is larger than the text.
Verify the presence of the tactical/glamour contrast in the subject's attire.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Left) + WhiteSpace(Center) + RightAlignedTypography(Right) = Modern Glamour Layout
